annotations.title: Submit answers to a Coral couples quiz

description: Saves one person's answers to a quiz they started or joined: one option for each of the ten questions. When both people have submitted, the reply includes the shared comparison, which shows only the answers both people chose. Submitting again changes nothing.

answers.description: One answer per question. Every question must be answered.

participantToken.description: This person's participant token, returned when they started or joined the quiz.

sessionId.description: The session ID returned when the quiz was started or joined.
